description: PG-03: per-capability rules for the Grant model (PERMISSION_GRANT_UNIFICATION_PLAN_2026-10-19 §2.2/§5/§6). standing_grant capabilities are stored by libs/core/governance/grant-store.ts; per_mission and os_permission capabilities are read through adapters by libs/core/governance/grant-resolver.ts. external_io=true means granting needs a human approval bound by payloadHash to the grant (basis.approval_request_id). readiness_profiles (PG-06) list the capabilities a kind of work needs; `pnpm kyberion grants status` and meeting preflight evaluate them.
